args.body: Execute the existing bilingual documentation buyer-request mission. Use the CanadaBuys capture if readable and relevant, and count only specific paid notices toward the two-request limit. Preserve the observed GitHub search rejection as specific to that discovery route. Verify the deadline, requested deliverables, supplier prerequisites and submission route from the buyer's notice before writing. For one qualifying request, create a copy-ready sample section against an actual buyer criterion and verify it on a clearly fictional import fixture. Include the exact submission prerequisites and separate evidence for acceptance and settlement. Read back the committed result before closing with a valid lease and lesson. No external submission, account creation, spending or deployment.
